# Shop99

> Shop99 (shop99.co.in) is an online store in India for car accessories — car speakers, amplifiers, Android car stereos/infotainment systems, BassTubes, and other car audio & electronic accessories. Operated by Prakash Electronics (India).

Shop99 sells genuine, brand-sourced car audio and electronics products with pan-India doorstep delivery, competitive pricing, and manufacturer warranty support (including for products bought elsewhere, via the Warranty Register page).

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.shop99.co.in/): Featured products, deals, and brand categories.
- [Shop](https://www.shop99.co.in/shop): Full product catalog, filterable by category and brand.
- [Categories](https://www.shop99.co.in/categories): Browse products by category.
- [Brands](https://www.shop99.co.in/brands): Browse products by brand.
- [Deals](https://www.shop99.co.in/deals): Current discounts and offers.
- [Most Selling Products](https://www.shop99.co.in/most-selling-products): Best-selling products.
- [Blog](https://www.shop99.co.in/blog): Buying guides and articles about car audio/accessories.
- [Warranty Register](https://www.shop99.co.in/warranty-register): Register a product for manufacturer warranty, whether bought from Shop99 or another retailer.
- [About](https://www.shop99.co.in/about): About Shop99 / Prakash Electronics (India).
- [Contact](https://www.shop99.co.in/contact): Contact and support details.

## Notes

- Prices, stock, and offers change frequently — always verify current details on the live page rather than relying on cached content.
- Product pages are at `/productPage/:slug`; category listings are reachable via `/shop?category=<name>`.
